deviations_from_card: Per the revision, the walk acceptance case is dropped (8 cases; the guard is now index 7, 0-based). With its case gone, walk mode (Prev/Next on the L2 card head) was not built, so Card.tsx and card/Head.tsx are untouched (which also leaves them clear for slot A); the tray offers 'Review the first' (opens the first ticked card) instead. The pure module is shell/tray-plan.ts, not shell/tray.ts: beside shell/Tray.tsx the two names collide on a case-insensitive file system (tsc TS1149 on Windows). The category is 'retainer' (the CATEGORIES enum), not 'retainers'. The batch is createBatch() returning a runner with busy(), not a free runBatch, so the single-flight flag has an owner. Red-before was measured against a stub tray module whose functions throw, so each case failed on its own; the guard case was red before only because its module did not exist. ADR 0147 added.
